assembly_suffix.help_text: Suffix appended to each sample_col value to form the assembly filename. Only used when a species' assembly path is a directory.

sample_col.help_text: Column name in the metadata containing sample identifiers, matched against assembly filenames.

group_label.help_text: Column name in the metadata file used to group genome assemblies into colour sets. The per-species metadata file, assembly path and target_groups come in on BUILD_COLOR_INDEX's samples channel, not as params.

bg_index.help_text: Pre-built background SBWT index (ATB) that bg_excl (C)/markers (G) are diffed against when --bg_excl_index isn't set. Must be built at the same --color_index_kmer_size as the rest of this pipeline's indexes.

bg_excl_index.help_text: Path to an already-built bg_excl (step08 'C', background - species_index) SBWT index to reuse directly, skipping the hugemem-scale --bg_index diff. Leave empty to compute bg_excl from --bg_index instead.

temp_dir.help_text: Shared scratch root for GGCAT/SBWT (and future set_diff_calculations.nf) temp/working dirs. Optional -- falls back to a task-local work directory per tool, which is fine at species scale. Only set this to a Lustre scratch path with confirmed free space if running at full background-DB scale (ATB/GTDB), which needs terabytes free. Each tool writes under '<temp_dir>/<tool>/' -- assumes only one build runs against a given temp_dir at a time.

color_index_kmer_size.help_text: k-mer size used consistently across the GGCAT, SBWT and Themisto2 builds in this subworkflow. Must match the k-mer size of any existing index (e.g. background SBWT/ATB/GTDB) this output will later be compared or set-differenced against.
